name: pr-workflows
description: Build reviewable PR stacks, write clear descriptions, explain PR changes, and understand review comments.

interface.shortDescription: PR stacks, descriptions, code walkthroughs, and comments
interface.longDescription: Plan reviewable PR stacks, write concise descriptions, explain PR changes step by step, and understand review comments.
defaultPrompt: Split this large change into a reviewable stack of pull requests.
Write a concise pull request description for this change.
Restack these pull requests after their base changed.
Walk me through the code changes in this PR in plain language.
Read the review comments on PR #123 and explain them one at a time.
